key_insight: MBUndo automatically replaces unitary ancilla uncomputation with sound measurement-based uncomputation, reducing costly T gates.
engineering_relevance: As a compiler pass, MBUndo can optimize existing uncomputation synthesizers’ outputs using only ancilla-qubit annotations.
method: Statically identify circuit positions where measuring each ancilla is sound.
Transform unitary uncomputation gates into phase corrections after measurement.
Integrate analysis and transformations into an automatic compiler pass.
evidence_signal: Across 22 benchmarks, the abstract reports T-gate reductions greater than 36.5% over uncomputation synthesizers.
watch_item: T-gate savings do not alone establish runtime gains; measurement and phase-correction overheads must be assessed on the target architecture.
paper_title: MBUndo: Sound, Automatic, and Efficient Measurement-Based Uncomputation for Quantum Circuits
